**KJAK04*** is a medical procedure code designating laparoscopy and peritoneal lavage. Within the context of Danish healthcare quality monitoring, this code is significant for its inclusion in the population definition of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] [^src1]. 

The inclusion of KJAK04* represents a methodological adjustment and an expansion of the database's tracked population [^src1]. This update was implemented to ensure complete coverage of relevant acute surgical procedures, as these specific interventions are utilized in the treatment of relevant patients at certain hospitals [^src1]. The expansion of the population definition, which also incorporated related codes such as KJAK01* and KJAK03*, is part of a broader initiative to refine quality indicators and improve treatment standards in acute surgery across Denmark [^src1].
